description: This file declares the RefRadioModem class, which inherits from android::hardware::radio::compat::RadioModem, and includes a method getImei. It serves as a header for radio modem reference implementation in the Android RIL (Radio Interface Layer).

classes.name: RefRadioModem
classes.description: A class inheriting from android::hardware::radio::compat::RadioModem, providing a method to get IMEI.

methods.name: getImei
methods.description: Overrides the base class method to retrieve the IMEI number given a serial number.
